Title: NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):\nBlowing those fuses up should give you access to the coolant system.
Translation: 斯文·维京（无线电）：\n炸掉那些保险丝应该能让你进入冷却系统。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):\nDraining the coolant water will make the reactor in the central room overheat and explode.
Translation: 斯文·维京（无线电）：\n排空冷却水会使中央房间的反应堆过热并爆炸。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Nih:\nWatch out, we managed to sneak around a whole enemy squad down there.\nGet there and blow them all up. See you topside.
Translation: 尼赫：\n小心，我们成功绕过了下面一整队敌人。\n到那里把他们全部炸飞。上面见。

Title: NETMESSAGE:KEYCARD FOUND\n\nControl Room unlocked.
Translation: 已找到钥匙卡\n\n控制室已解锁。

Title: NETMESSAGE:DUAL KEYCARDS FOUND\n\nFuse box room unlocked.
Translation: 已找到双钥匙卡\n\n保险丝盒室已解锁。

Title:
NETMESSAGE:EMERGENCY!!

RADIOACTIVE EXPLOSION DANGER!
10 SECONDS LEFT!
Translation:
紧急情况！！

放射性爆炸危险！
还剩10秒！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):\nThe container should take care of that locked door ahead.\nActivate the transportation device.
Translation: 斯文·维京（无线电）：\n集装箱应该能解决前面那扇锁着的门。\n启动运输装置。

Title: NETMESSAGE:ITEM ACQUIRED\n\nTransport rail maintenance key.
Translation: 已获得物品\n\n运输轨道维护钥匙。
